constraints: USD spherical joint has no drive support; writing drive attributes alone would be ineffective
A passive-damping migration would require a separately validated joint representation, e.g. a D6 with translations locked and all rotations free
D6 translational locks use low > high; preserve original bodies, joint frames, gravity and collision properties
Use zero stiffness and zero velocity target for damping; never use positive target rotation to drive cube turns
Armature and joint friction effort require articulation; do not claim ordinary joints migrate these parameters
